title: PBR materials, textures and HDRIs (CC0 sources and their fine print)
description: Physically based materials and HDR environment maps for Blender renders, Godot 4 WorldEnvironment skies and moving background plates. Poly Haven, ambientCG, cgbookcase and 3dtextures.me are CC0; ShareTextures is "custom CC0" that forbids automated downloads; BlenderKit and Fab use their own royalty-free licences.

items.title: Poly Haven (HDRIs, textures, models)
items.summary: Unclipped HDRIs up to 16k+, photoscanned PBR textures at 8k+ and hyperreal models, all CC0, no account needed.
cautions: CC0 does not clear trademarks or real-world locations/brands visible in scans.
You may not claim to be the original author or re-license the assets as your own.

items.title: Poly Haven FAQ (licence)
items.summary: Official FAQ: assets are CC0; the only restriction is not claiming authorship or re-licensing; AI training is allowed.

items.title: 3DTextures.me
items.summary: Seamless PBR materials for Blender, Unreal, Unity and Godot; recent pages state CC0, free for personal and commercial use, no attribution.
cautions: Some higher resolutions (for example 4K) or source files are Patreon-only; the CC0 statement covers the free downloads.

items.title: 3DTextures.me FAQ / textures licence
items.summary: FAQ page: textures are free; the author forbids claiming authorship; redistribution allowed.

items.title: ShareTextures
items.summary: 1,600+ textures and 250+ models (site figures) under a 'custom CC0' licence with extra restrictions.
items.licence: Custom: CC0-based with restrictions (see licence page)
cautions: Automated downloads and embedding in third-party apps (for example Blender add-ons) are NOT allowed: an agent must not bulk-fetch from this site.
Redistribution on other sites, plugins or collections needs written permission. Use only files you downloaded from sharetextures.com yourself.

items.title: ShareTextures licence
items.summary: Custom CC0 terms: commercial use allowed, attribution optional, but no redistribution without permission, no automated downloads, no hateful/violent/illegal use.

items.title: BlenderKit licences (Royalty Free and CC0)
items.summary: BlenderKit assets are either Royalty Free (commercial use without credit, no resale of the asset in original form, including inside asset packs or game levels sold on marketplaces) or CC0.
items.licence: Royalty Free (BlenderKit) or CC0, per asset
cautions: Royalty Free assets cannot be redistributed as assets; never copy them into a Baltor package or public repo.

items.title: CG Channel: Megascans free on Fab until end of 2024
items.summary: October 2024 report: Megascans moved to Epic's Fab under the Fab Standard License (usable in any engine or tool); the free period ended with 2024, with a smaller free cross-section promised for 2025.
cautions: 2024 article; read the current Fab Standard License on fab.com before use.
Fab assets are licensed to the account that claimed them; never redistribute the files.
